task_status_policy: Read task checklists from the manifest; this map defines architecture, not another task database.
invariants: Preserve existing source owners; add adapters before replacing a core.
Native credentials, browser profiles, local permissions and live Codex databases stay on their owning computer.
Receive, verify, stage, adopt, index and expose context are separate effects and receipts.
Source checks and dependency readiness are not runtime permission or actual-device acceptance.
Preserve divergence, uncertain effects and partial output; never overwrite conflicts or retry unknown effects blindly.
Private roots, identity hashes, raw chats and task-system identifiers remain outside Git and OneDrive.
A central proposal never weakens destination exclusions, local approval or immediate stop.
No background service, network pairing, Codex installation change, API evaluation or production migration is enabled by this map.
ai_workflow: Read the selected task packet and applicable current instructions.
Verify cited source hashes and search existing owners before writing a new implementation.
Propose the smallest additive change with typed inputs, outputs, effects and failure states.
Implement one bounded vertical workflow and reuse the existing read/write/journal/approval owners.
Run checks appropriate to the change; record source, synthetic, platform, human and multi-device evidence separately.
Save stage conclusions and update the existing GitHub/TickTick task; never close an unaccepted checklist item.

core.label: Identity, schemas and stable references

contract.input: Selected logical IDs, source locator and exact revision
contract.output: Validated references with separate private device bindings
contract.invariant: A label or drive letter never substitutes for identity; schema data never grants filesystem authority.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

core.label: Guarded storage and selected routing

contract.input: Explicit selected roots, content class and expected source digest
contract.output: Verified managed destination or an explicit refusal
contract.invariant: No silent OS-drive fallback; preserve existing bytes and reject links, sensitive paths and ambiguous clones.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

core.label: Local revisions, journals and recovery evidence

contract.input: Exact reviewed intent, expected revision and local ownership
contract.output: Append-only result receipt, uncertainty or inspectable partial output
contract.invariant: Existing cooperative local locks are not distributed consensus; checkpoint ancestry belongs to its new format adapter.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

core.label: Policy, local identity and authorization

contract.input: Actor, device generation, project/storage scope, policy revision and intended capability
contract.output: Explained effective policy and destination-local authorization decision
contract.invariant: Transport is not adoption; configuration authority is not execution approval; stop stays locally usable.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

core.label: Explicit lifecycle transition protocol

contract.input: Selected manifest/object revisions, current phase and authorized requested transition
contract.output: One transition result with receipt and next boundary
contract.invariant: Implement missing stages additively; STAGES declarations and managed placement are not an end-to-end sync engine.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

core.label: Bounded source projections and human views

contract.input: Explicit source selection and disclosure/retention scope
contract.output: Source-linked graph, activity summary and accessible report
contract.invariant: Fetch detail on demand; show declared, observed, missing and stale evidence separately.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

core.label: Task-scoped implementation context

contract.input: One MCI task ID, current checklist manifest and selected build map
contract.output: Small implementation packet with owners, prerequisites and verification boundaries
contract.invariant: Derive status from the existing manifest; no second task queue, automatic dispatch or hidden memory.

core.extension_rule: Extend these owners; do not create a parallel registry, journal or approval system.

systems.label: Managed storage and physical-drive/file handover
systems.variation: Checkpoint manifests, full/delta packaging, exclusive moved-drive handover and destination rebinding.

contract.input: Selected vault + common parent + explicitly included objects

systems.acceptance: Reopen selected files on another computer, verify hashes and return-transfer without transplanting local auth.

systems.label: Parallel replicas and N-device reconciliation
systems.variation: Ancestry, per-replica acknowledgements, text/structured merge adapters, tombstones and retirement.

contract.input: Common ancestor and independently changed branches
contract.output: Merged candidate or preserved conflicts; no silent adoption

systems.acceptance: Offline concurrent edits preserve both versions and reconcile predictably across at least three logical replicas.

systems.label: Network share, direct peer and cloud transports
systems.variation: Separate adapters implement provider availability, resumable byte transfer, peer authentication and provider revision/permission semantics.

contract.input: Immutable approved objects + manifest + destination policy
contract.output: Received bytes and transfer receipt; never implicit adoption

systems.acceptance: Run one transport conformance suite per provider plus actual endpoint acceptance; no live database share.

systems.label: Central proposals and local account/device controls
systems.variation: Local Windows account verification on each machine, optional future pairing adapter and source/destination policy administration.

contract.output: Destination acknowledgement or refusal + current lifecycle/stop state

systems.acceptance: Human Windows success/cancel remains pending; remote trust is separately accepted, never inferred from a shared account name.

systems.label: Local information source and stable-reference resolver
systems.variation: Resolve logical resources to authorized local, Git, Drive or remote owners while retaining existing provider URLs.

contract.input: Stable resource reference + client route + selected revision
contract.output: Authorized source bytes or explicit stale/unavailable result

systems.acceptance: Pilot selected sources without deleting Drive originals; verify link resolution and permissions in every required client.

systems.label: Codex continuity and source-linked chat packets
systems.variation: Supported continuation adapter versus new-chat context packet; preserve identity/lineage/attachments and version-specific evidence.

contract.input: Selected consistent snapshot or explicit bounded source-linked continuation
contract.output: Clearly labeled native continuation, fork or new-chat packet

systems.acceptance: Actual subsequent turn, restart and return transfer are required before claiming native continuity; no production database edits.

systems.label: Scoped remote named operations
systems.variation: Typed capability and target adapter reuse the target approval/operation owner; file transfer, remote UI and execution handoff remain distinct.

contract.input: Authenticated operation ID + expiry + scope + expected revision

systems.acceptance: One bounded named action accepted on two physical hosts; reconnect never blindly replays an uncertain action.

systems.label: Human architecture, instruction and activity control center
systems.variation: Compact source-bound explorer, contextual disclosure, status/changes/chat summaries and device comparison.

contract.input: Authorized metadata projections and source/retention choices
contract.output: Understandable human view with exact source/evidence and next decision

systems.acceptance: Reuse existing renderer/UI; test navigation, accessibility, source links and detail-on-demand without operational side effects.

systems.label: Minimal request preflight and optional model evaluation
systems.variation: Static intent/default/ambiguity check first; repeated frozen-context model trials only through an accepted evaluation adapter.

contract.input: Original request + selected observable context + intended outcome
contract.output: Original-preserving suggestion and evidence; optional measured evaluation results

systems.acceptance: Do not optimize token count alone or promise exact model behavior; optional API work retains separate credential/budget gates.

systems.label: Optional portable companion/runtime launcher
systems.variation: Thin OS/runtime adapter over the same core, only if feasibility and actual-host acceptance pass.

contract.input: Selected runtime release + explicit local setup + portable project reference
contract.output: Supported launch/registration/update/rollback receipt, or unsupported status

systems.acceptance: Files and context continuity work independently of this optional runtime path; never copy credentials or whole Codex configuration.

criteria: All enabled required task checklists accepted.
Two-device/offline/concurrent/reconnect and granular recovery demonstrated for advertised modes.
Optional model/runtime paths accepted independently or explicitly excluded.
